tools.name: search_live_room_quotes
tools.description: Read live SiteMinder room rates and availability via Casona Direct Booking for dates and guest counts. Includes COP full-stay totals, room and rate names and date-prefilled direct booking links. Never confirms a booking.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Search the full Casona Signature v18 draft service catalog: filter by category (dining/spa/extras/rooms/tours/transport), venue (Costa/Vuelo), and exact menu category (Breakfast/Signature cocktail/Wine bottle). Returns COP price references, not live availability.

tools.name: draft_experience_quote
tools.description: Calculate a non-binding draft subtotal in COP from service IDs and quantities. Exclude all unknown prices; never claim a confirmed reservation or quote.
